records.headline: Commercial season delayed to at least Jan 1, 2027 (humpback whale entanglements).
records.detail: CDFW delayed the commercial season in Zones 1–5 because of humpback whale entanglement risk, not domoic acid. The delay lasts at least until Jan 1, 2027.
